question.text: Per the current NISM V-A workbook framework, which distributors are eligible for additional commission/incentives over and above the regular trail commission, as specified by SEBI?

answer.text: Only distributors that onboard institutional investors above an AUM threshold
Distributors that onboard new individual investors from B-30 cities, and distributors that onboard women investors, as specified by SEBI from time to time
Distributors that onboard any existing mutual fund investor, regardless of city or gender
All distributors at a fixed 30 basis points additional TER on every Regular Plan inflow

explanation.text: The Logic: The current NISM V-A workbook describes an additional commission/incentive framework targeted at onboarding new individual investors from beyond top-30 (B-30) cities and women investors, as specified by SEBI from time to time. The rate is not stated as a fixed 30 bps additional TER on every inflow in the current workbook. The Trap: The earlier framing of "additional TER of up to 30 basis points on B-30 inflows" reflects the older rule. The current workbook describes the incentive in terms of new investors from B-30 cities and women investors, with specifics as notified by SEBI. Cross-Exam Context: NISM V-A and Chapter 5 (TER regulations) both reference this revised framework. Where a specific numeric rate is required for an exam answer, the source NISM circular notified by SEBI should be cited.
